keys.{item_apple_desc}: Crisp fruit that falls from chopped trees. Eat: +25 HP.
keys.{item_arrow_desc}: Ammunition for the bow. Crafted from wood and stone.
keys.{item_bomb_desc}: Throw it, then RUN. Clears a crater of rock and anything standing in it - the blast circle warns everyone first.
keys.{item_bow_desc}: Fires arrows exactly where you aim. Each shot uses one arrow.
keys.{item_chest_desc}: Sometimes hides inside broken rock. Walk over it to open.
keys.{item_coal_desc}: Black mineral fuel. Needed to forge diamond gear.
keys.{item_crystal_desc}: A glowing shard from deep rock.
keys.{item_diamond_desc}: The hardest gem there is. Crafts the finest tools.
keys.{item_diamond_pickaxe_desc}: Shatters rock in one blow, barely tiring you. Finds rare gems far more often.
keys.{item_diamond_shovel_desc}: Effortless tilling and a nasty edge when cornered.
keys.{item_diamond_sword_desc}: The last blade you will ever craft. Devastating and effortless.
keys.{item_ectoplasm_desc}: Cold residue left where a ghost fell. Slippery enough to make things move faster.
keys.{item_fish_desc}: Pulled out of the sea with a rod. Eat: +35 HP.
keys.{item_fishing_rod_desc}: Interact aiming at water to cast. When something bites you get a moment to Interact again - miss it and it gets away.
keys.{item_fists_desc}: Your own two hands. They can even fell a tree... eventually.
keys.{item_grapple_hook_desc}: Aim at rock or trees and Interact to haul yourself across. Needs something solid to bite into.
keys.{item_hamburger_desc}: A feast in your hands. Eat: fully restores HP.
keys.{item_heart_container_desc}: Forged from four beating shards. Use it to raise your maximum health for good.
keys.{item_heart_shard_desc}: Still beating, faintly. Four of them can be forged into a Heart Container.
keys.{item_iron_desc}: Ore chipped from rock, flecked with rust-orange. Crafts iron-tier tools.
keys.{item_iron_pickaxe_desc}: Bites through trees and rock, and finds gems more often.
keys.{item_iron_shovel_desc}: Tills quickly and hits harder than lesser shovels.
keys.{item_iron_sword_desc}: A soldier's blade: fast, sharp and reliable.
keys.{item_leather_strap_desc}: Cut from any animal you hunt - birds and bugs included. Craftable from a Thick Hide too. Binds a saddle together and strings a fishing rod.
keys.{item_mushroom_desc}: Grows wherever a witch has been. Eat: +10 HP - or brew it into something better.
keys.{item_octopus_desc}: A rare catch, and a big meal. Eat: +55 HP.
keys.{item_pet_charm_desc}: A tiny animal took a liking to you. Equip and Interact to have it follow you around - or to send it home.
keys.{item_pizza_desc}: Still warm, somehow. Turns up in chests. Eat: +60 HP.
keys.{item_portal_stone_desc}: Plant it where you stand to open a named portal. You may have five of them standing at once - walk into any portal to travel to another, or to take your own back.
keys.{item_potato_desc}: Humble but filling chest loot. Eat: +20 HP.
keys.{item_regen_potion_desc}: Drink: slowly knit yourself back together over the next few seconds.
keys.{item_rotten_flesh_desc}: Torn from a zombie. Too foul to eat, but it packs a bomb nicely.
keys.{item_saddle_desc}: Interact next to any animal to ride it - faster beasts carry you faster. While riding, Interact with anything in hand to climb back down; you cannot saddle a second animal until you do.
keys.{item_sock_desc}: Someone lost this at sea. Now it is your problem. Equip it to wear it - does nothing whatsoever.
keys.{item_speed_potion_desc}: Drink: move much faster for a short while. Brewed from witch essence.
keys.{item_stone_desc}: Chipped rock from boulders. Combine with wood to craft tools. Right-click on bare ground to place it as a block.
keys.{item_stone_pickaxe_desc}: Faster on wood and stone than a wooden pick.
keys.{item_stone_shovel_desc}: Tills farmland and doubles as a passable club.
keys.{item_stone_sword_desc}: Heavy edge that hits hard but drains stamina fast.
keys.{item_strength_potion_desc}: Drink: your swings hit much harder for a short while.
keys.{item_swift_boots_desc}: Hide-and-ectoplasm soles. Equip them to wear them - permanently quicker on your feet while worn.
keys.{item_thick_hide_desc}: Tough skin off a brute or a big animal. Cut into boots, straps and saddles.
keys.{item_tree_seed_desc}: Falls from chopped trees. Interact with tilled farmland to plant it - grows into a sapling, then into a full tree.
keys.{item_watermelon_desc}: Juicy crop harvested from grown farmland. Eat: +50 HP.
keys.{item_wheat_seed_desc}: Tilling grass with a shovel often turns one up. Interact with tilled farmland to plant it - grows into a watermelon crop.
keys.{item_witch_essence_desc}: The spark that kept a witch aloft. Every potion starts here.
keys.{item_witch_hat_desc}: A real witch's hat, barely singed. Equip it to wear it - does nothing but look great.
keys.{item_wood_desc}: Sturdy timber from trees. The base of most recipes. Right-click on bare ground to place it as a wood block.
keys.{item_wooden_pickaxe_desc}: Chops trees and cracks rock, slowly. Your first real tool.
keys.{item_wooden_shovel_desc}: Strike grass to till it into farmland, then plant seeds on it.
keys.{item_wooden_sword_desc}: A trusty plank with a point. Better than fists against the night.
keys.{left_before_the_fight_is_lost}: left before the fight is lost!
keys.{night_falls}: Night falls... the dead are walking.
keys.{no_animal_close_enough}: No animal close enough to saddle.
keys.{no_arrows_craft_some}: No arrows! Craft some (1 wood + 1 stone).
